description: Agent Inventory: submit consignment stock records with the sale and settlement records they answer to: the consignment with its reference, consignor, currency, the commission percent the store keeps, the days within which the consignor is settled and each consigned item with its units; each sale with its reference, item, day, units and amount; each settlement with its reference, the sale it settles, the day paid and the amount paid to the consignor; optionally the owned stock counted with each item and units, and the shrinkage write-offs with each item, units, day and reason. The signed report gives the consignment, the sales, each sale of consigned stock against the settlements to the consignor, each consigned item against the owned stock counted, each settlement amount against the sale less the stated commission, and each consigned item against the shrinkage write-offs, and counts them, and names divergent consignment records: a consigned item sold with no settlement to the consignor, consigned stock counted as owned stock, a settlement amount that does not match the sale record, and consigned stock written off as shrinkage; then a settlement paid after the stated settlement days and a settlement naming no recorded sale, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No consigned items, no sale of a consigned item, no owned stock count, no commission, or no write-off list leaves those points unverified. A sale is of consigned stock when its item is on the consignment, the amount due is the sale amount less the commission percent, and supplied owned stock and write-off lists with no rows read as none; items match by their SKU or their words, sales and settlements by their references read as letters and digits, amounts compare to the cent and dates by the day. This reads stock held for others against what was sold and paid over to them. Verdict inventory_consignment_divergent, inventory_consignment_partial, inventory_consignment_unverified or inventory_consignment_consistent. POST /api/inventory-consignment-check. Reads the inventory records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it never moves stock, never places or cancels an order, never writes to anyone’s inventory system and never adjusts a record, which stay with the business and its staff, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Inventory reads inventory records: a stock count, receiving records, shrinkage and loss records, a stock adjustment log, an inventory valuation, reorder records, a dead stock record and consignment stock records, each against the system stock record, the purchase or consignment orders, the count and sales records, the count and the period close, the counts and purchase records, the stock levels and lead times, the movement window and period report, or the sale and settlement records it answers to. The family checks whether the stock record can be trusted; the Agent Bookkeeping family reads the ledger the stock feeds, and the boutique tools act on one store’s orders. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-inventory-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-inventory/.

commission_percent.description: The percent of each sale the store keeps.

settle_within_days.description: Days after a sale to settle the consignor.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

owned_stock.description: Each item counted as owned stock.
